gloss: sweet bean paste; thick starchy sauce

definitions.gloss: sweet bean paste, red bean paste, filling (for wagashi)
definitions.explanation: Most commonly refers to sweet paste made from azuki beans, used in Japanese confections. Can be smooth (koshi-an) or chunky (tsubu-an).
Refers to thickened sauces used in Chinese and Japanese cuisine, often made with starch.

notes:
Sense 1 is the everyday meaning; in casual speech it is often ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧. Sense 2 is a savory sauce thickened with ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧ (potato starch), mostly in Chinese-style dishes.

COMPOUNDS:
- {粒餡|つぶあん}: chunky bean paste, with the beans partly whole
- {漉|こ}し{餡|あん}: smooth, strained bean paste
- {白餡|しろあん}: white bean paste, made from white beans
- ⟦{餡|あん}かけ→餡かけ：28727_ankake⟧: a dish topped with thick savory sauce

WRITING: Often written in hiragana, あん.
